gaps: ImageTexture and PixelTexture faces are drawn and compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 by pixel probes (right and bottom faces are PixelTextures); MovieTexture faces are not drawn (a video element is not read for a background)

transparency lowers the alpha of the sky and the six faces (checked in ours only); what shows through is the body's clear colour, which the stock Background node still sets from its first Background, where X_ITE shows the page behind
the sky sphere has 48 segments and a ring every 1/32 of PI plus one at every angle, so a gradient is stepped finer than the eye sees; colours are linear between rings
the sky is a sphere of radius 900 around the camera, the six faces a cube of half-size 500 inside it; scenes with a camera far clip below 900 would cut it (the body uses at least 2000)
